documents.why: The whole card is in this document: the marks (10), the courses (the last two pages), the race area and starting line (8.1, 12.1) and the finish (14).

meta.name: Brass Monkey Winter Series 2025 racing marks

details.note: The SI's table gives no shapes or colours, and puts Portmarnock at 53° 25.2′ N 06° 04.00′ W — open water between Hub and Viceroy, 1.3 NM from where the SI's own picture and the Autumn League 2025 technical sheet have it. The same club's marks: the sheet's shape, colour and, for P, position are taken as canonical.
